Telemetry processing consumer with Postgres rollups and observability reads

Messages, the Profile and folded replies are read ahead, behind the preloading switch that stays off for build 196; measured on a device with the switch off, none of six paths is less smooth than main. It is turned on from the server once the videos ahead are ready, without a new build.

Take icons back to build 195: the ghost, repost, send and comments on the left, the vote count on the right, keeping the night's fixes (hidden zeros, touch zones on iPhone). Two reviews at zero, before and after captures.
Reassure fluidity gate on every pull request touching the app
fix(web): bind the owned staging QA account through its session, not the sign-in body

Notifications: reading marks exactly what was shown, in the real order of arrival, never by date; an old app keeps working as before.
Profile: from Questions, a swipe right goes back to Takes instead of closing the profile, and no tap goes through a closing screen; measured on a device, no tap lost and as smooth as main.

Take icons: votes on the left, the rest on the right, with build 195's spacing; a zero stays hidden but keeps its place, so nothing moves when a count arrives. You switched back to build 195 an hour later (see the icon row in progress).
Telemetry ingest Worker with staging infra and SDK compat tests
Notifications: past 50 unread, a visit turns the badge off again, up to the newest one shown; a notification arriving during the visit stays unread. Measured on a device, as smooth as main.
Two quick taps on the ghost no longer turn an anonymous vote public: the tap reads your current choice, not the last drawing.
Composer: a Take resumed after the app was killed shows up in Friends again, a video keeps its real portrait frame, and a published photo stays; measured on a device, publishing as smooth as main.
Test only: a vote test no longer waits 3 s for the feed to retry; the app itself never waited.
A vote you chose to make anonymous now stays anonymous, even after a stale copy, a share or a later page; measured on a device, 160 votes out of 160 followed the ghost, as smooth as main.

claude.libelle: A Claude is fixing it here

enCours.sujet: Hashtags tapped right in the title, grey like 'See translation', no pills
enCours.ouEnEst: Your request at 10:04; you liked it at 10:33. Since then, a translated title keeps the Take's own hashtags tappable (a tag the translation rewrote stays plain text, a tag it dropped is added at the end), and the empty band left under 'See translation' is folded, so a translated Take with hashtags has the same spacing as one without. Two reviews of these last changes found zero defects, and the build checks are green.
enCours.reste: Before and after pictures of that band in light and dark, your OK, then merge.

enCours.sujet: Map ready before you arrive, like Snap
enCours.ouEnEst: None of the first three versions scrolls Friends as smoothly as main. Three new versions isolate the cause: D keeps main's map component as is, E carries only the new swipe gestures, F only the small globe and the Home screen hooks. Replicas is down, so they are measured here on your emulator: six runs per side, in alternating order.
enCours.reste: The heavy version points to the cause: fix it, measure again, review, merge. Joins build 196 only once it is as smooth as main.

enCours.ouEnEst: Every flow passed on today's main once the bench's own test data were fixed; the bench now restores its data before each loop.
enCours.reste: Final full loop and the 90-point tour on the final main, after the hashtags and the map.

enCours.sujet: Switching on Messages and the Profile read ahead
enCours.ouEnEst: Merged and switched off in build 196. Measured switched on: Messages opens much faster and videos are unchanged, but launch gets a bit heavier, because the preparation falls during startup.
enCours.reste: After build 196: move that preparation after launch, then switch it on from the server.

enCours.sujet: Videos ahead in the feed with preloading on
enCours.ouEnEst: One video piece per video, no more cancelling while the video stays near. You put it after build 196.
enCours.reste: Measure, then turn the video switch on.

equipe: Here on the Mac: me, your emulator (measuring the map versions), and one Claude agent running that measurement. The Mac is near its memory limit, so the after-build work starts as soon as room frees up.
On Replicas: every message to a machine has failed since about 11:20, and their devices answer with errors. Work moves back there once they recover.
etapes: Measure the three map versions against main on your emulator, find what makes Friends heavier, fix it, then measure again.
Take pictures of the band under 'See translation', get your OK, then merge the hashtags.
Final full test loop and the 90-point tour on the final main, then the list of what is not in build 196, the build itself, and your emulator back on staging.

Start the after-build work on the Mac, one task at a time while Replicas is down: Messages and the Profile prepared after launch, hashtags on the website, the longest Take text, Explorer, and the local test data.
